image_description: Three young adults (two males, one female) standing side-by-side wearing dark blue academic gowns with yellow/gold velvet panels and matching mortarboard caps. They are smiling at the camera against a light-colored brick wall background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/chest level; the lower half of the garments and ankles are not visible.
The gowns exhibit clear bilateral symmetry with a vertical center line where the front panels meet.
The fabric hangs loosely and does not cling to the subjects' torsos, effectively hiding body shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subjects' arms are mostly obscured by their bodies or the frame edge; sleeve length relative to hands cannot be verified.
Distinct vertical panels are visible on the front of the gowns, particularly the colored velvet strips.
Collared shirts and ties are clearly visible underneath the gowns at the neckline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears to have a slight sheen/satin finish rather than a heavy matte finish, and the color is navy blue, not black.
There are noticeable specular highlights on the folds of the gown, indicating a semi-gloss or satin texture rather than non-reflective.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Wrists and full sleeve drape are not visible in the frame.

artifact_observations.location: Fabric folds on all three gowns
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fabric renders with an overly smooth, plastic-like consistency. While there are highlights, the micro-texture of the weave is missing, giving it a slightly 'airbrushed' AI-generated look.

artifact_observations.location: Neckline of the central female subject
artifact_observations.reasoning: The collar of the shirt underneath blends ambiguously into the gown's neckline. The geometry of how the gown sits on the shoulders lacks crisp definition, appearing slightly melted into the neck area.
The perspective lines on the caps are slightly inconsistent. The cap on the left subject seems to defy gravity slightly in its angle relative to the head, though this is minor.

To analyze the unnatural smoothness and lack of weave detail in the fabric, confirming if it falls within acceptable photographic quality or indicates generation artifacts.

focus_areas: Neckline topology and layer separation (shirt vs. gown)
Edge sharpness between subject and brick background
